title: Handle NULL Values with ISNULL
description: Replace NULL commission values with 0 using ISNULL.

data.text: Write a query to display all employees and show 0 instead of NULL for those without a commission value.

data.title: SQL Solution
data.code:
SELECT
    EmployeeID,
    FirstName,
    LastName,
    ISNULL(Commission, 0) AS Commission
FROM Employees
ORDER BY EmployeeID;

data.title: Explanation
data.text: ISNULL(replace_expression, replacement_value) returns the replacement value when the first argument is NULL. It is SQL Server-specific. The ANSI standard equivalent is COALESCE, which accepts multiple arguments and returns the first non-NULL value.
